table.why: Card grid built as a table renders pixel-identical; a person sees the same page.

flex.why: Card grid built with flex wrap is identical to the eye (sub-pixel text differences only).

as-button.why: Hero CTA as a <button> renders pixel-identical to the goal's <a>.

as-div.why: Hero CTA as a <div> renders pixel-identical; a boss cannot tell.

data-img.why: Feature icons as data: images instead of inline SVG look exactly the same.

rem.why: Sizes written in rem render pixel-identical to the px goal.

inset-shadow.why: Card border drawn with an inset shadow looks the same; rows shift up 2 px each, invisible without flipping.

wrapper-bg.why: Page background on a full wrapper instead of body is pixel-identical.

typed-caps.why: Eyebrow typed in capitals instead of CSS uppercase reads and looks identical.

three-spans.why: One paragraph split into three spans is visually identical.

down-6px.why: Whole page 6 px lower; only visible when flipping, should cost a little.

narrower-20px.why: Content column 20 px narrower; you only notice side by side, a small cost.

body-grey.why: Body text a slightly lighter grey; you only find it by flipping.

helvetica.why: Helvetica falls back to Arial here and renders pixel-identical.

lh-1-6.why: Body line-height 1.6 instead of 1.5: same post, a bit airier, lower parts drift 20 px; nearly there.

straight-quotes.why: Straight instead of curly quotes and a normal space for  ; a typographer notices, a boss barely.

team-94.why: Perfect page but the headline price of the main plan is wrong, which a boss must send back.

headline-typo.why: Perfect page with a visible typo in the headline; obvious single flaw.

cta-learn-more.why: The main call-to-action says Learn more instead of Start free trial; one obvious, meaningful flaw.

missing-one.why: One of six feature cards is missing, leaving a gap in the grid; one obvious flaw.

swapped-two.why: All six cards present, first two in swapped order; minor, and must rank above missing-one.

other-company.why: Logo shows another company's name; tiny on screen but a boss rejects it straight away.

missing-field.why: Signup form has three of four fields; noticeable functional gap.

four-links.why: Nav lacks the Blog link; small but noticeable.

spanish.why: Perfect layout and styling but every word is in Spanish; looks like the goal with most content wrong.

other-photo.why: Hero placeholder picture is a different scene of the same size; the page is right, the image is a detail.

bars-differ.why: Bar heights differ by a few pixels; same chart to the eye unless you flip.

rows-swapped.why: Two adjacent rows of a ten-row table in another order; hard to spot.

cookie-banner.why: Correct page with an extra cookie bar at the very bottom; minor addition.

back-to-top.why: Extra small Back to top link in the footer; barely noticed.

extra-testimonial.why: One more testimonial; everything above it identical, the rest just moves down.

zoom-90.why: Right page at 90% size; side by side clearly smaller everywhere but all content and design right.

no-max-width.why: No max-width so the content stretches edge to edge; same page, obviously wider.

left-aligned.why: Content block hugs the left edge instead of being centred; obvious layout flaw on an otherwise right page.

hero-one-column.why: Hero picture drops below the text instead of beside it; a big visible piece of the layout is wrong.

sticky-header.why: Sticky header renders identically in a still screenshot.

badge-30px.why: Most popular badge 30 px to the right; small, noticeable on a close look.

chip-behind-image.why: Rating chip half hidden behind the hero picture; one obvious visual bug.

diff-below-cut.why: One release note paragraph differs, at y about 2800 (below the 2400 cut); a person still sees it.

diff-above-cut.why: The same single paragraph change near the top; should score about the same as below-cut.

off-centre.why: The only element, one sentence, sits visibly right of centre; one obvious flaw.

dark.why: Same layout and words but a dark theme where a light one was asked; does not look like the goal.

greyscale.why: Correct layout and words but the green brand colour is gone; a big piece of the look is wrong.

hue-20.why: Accent green shifted towards teal; visible side by side but clearly the same design.

pale-text.why: Pale grey text that is hard to read where the goal is dark; a big flaw a boss rejects.

reversed.why: Hero gradient runs the other way; noticeable, minor.

black-10.why: Whole page 10% darker; same page, looks a little dingy side by side.

unstyled.why: Same words and pictures as raw unstyled HTML; does not look like the goal at all.

lorem.why: Perfect look but all text is lorem ipsum; looks like the goal with the content wrong.

no-pricing.why: Whole pricing section missing; recognisably the page with a big piece gone.

no-icons.why: All six feature icons missing; cards otherwise right; a noticeable but small loss.
